contents.name: Diffusive action, continuity constraint, and SSEP coefficient convention

source_review.read_extent: Read all of Sections II.1–II.3 and the relevant SSEP coefficient discussion in V.D, including the displayed action and time-reversal formulas.
source_review.supports: The source uses D=1 and mobility chi(rho)=rho(1-rho) for the stated SSEP model and the quadratic current action with coefficient 1/4.
source_review.limitations: The source presents the macroscopic fluctuation framework and model-dependent coefficient inputs; this item defines a mathematical functional and does not claim the microscopic SSEP path-space LDP.

contents.name: Time reversal of density/current paths and action relation

source_review.limitations: The local theorem here specializes to the equilibrium SSEP current and proves its exact endpoint identity directly by algebra and periodic integration by parts.

contents.name: Equilibrium reverse-relaxation route and free-energy difference
